claims.sentence: Current academic control is the method used to check the quality of your progress in the Additional General Education Program
This control takes place during the academic period

It is conducted for the purposes of controlling the level of achievement of results provided by the program, conducting self-assessment, and evaluating your work to possibly improve the educational process
It systematically checks your individual assignments, preparation for classes, independent study of specific topics, and the completion of projects or essays
The control is conducted in the following forms
Oral control, which consists of oral questioning
Written control, which consists of written questioning and the completion of specific assignments
Test-based control, which consists of oral, written, computer, or electronic testing
Students, you use this process to conduct self-assessment and receive an evaluation of your work from the teacher
The teacher uses this evaluation to possibly improve the educational process
The control systematically checks your individual assignments, preparation for classes, independent study of specific topics, and the completion of projects or essays
It also verifies your achievement of the results provided by the program
The evidence does not specify deadlines, grading scales, or frequency for these forms of control
It does not list which specific assignments, projects, or essays are required for each course
It does not detail how computer or electronic testing is administered or which platforms are used
The evidence does not explain what happens if a student fails to meet the program results
Course pages may provide additional details, but the official regulation does not cover them
